name: Sample prompts (no audio)
description: Manifest schema example. These entries are sentences to be read by real speakers; no audio ships with the app, so every entry is reported as missing audio and is skipped until a recording is added at its audioFile path. Transcripts must be edited to match what the speaker actually said.
